queries_run: Booking Holdings market share gaining OR losing 2026
Booking Holdings AI agents new entrant disintermediate OTC threat 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：Google 將旅遊搜尋整合進 Maps 與 Gemini，其他大型科技平台與 AI 原生業者正開發可直接搜尋、比價、訂位的 Gen AI 助理，可能減少直接流量並使 OTC 被繞過；Gen AI 亦降低進入門檻。
findings.excerpt: Other large technology platforms and AI-native competitors are developing Gen AI-powered assistants and agents that can search, compare, recommend, and facilitate travel and dining reservations directly within their search engines, operating systems, messaging platforms, or "super-apps."

findings.claim: 10-K：部分對手願意零利潤或虧損以搶份額，亞洲尤其盛行折扣與優惠券，折扣會壓低 ADR 與營收占訂單比。
findings.excerpt: In some cases, our competitors are willing to make little or no profit on a transaction or offer travel services at a loss in order to gain market share.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋結果僅有二手評論，無權威第三方份額資料；摘要不可逐字複製故以 clues 列出。

clues.claim: 2026-09 下旬 Meta 個人 AI 代理 Muse 被報導可直接與航空公司或飯店完成訂位，Booking 股價當日跌約 5%，Expedia 跌 7%、Airbnb 跌 6%。
MarketScreener 評論稱 Booking 自行處理旅客付款的訂單占比 12 個月內由 63% 升至 70%，並據此論述其在取得份額。
clues.source: MarketScreener, Booking: guilty until proven innocent
